summary: Frontend-only verification of new Payslip feature: Company Profile dialog, per-row PDF/Email buttons, Download-all, and staff form 'Payslip details' section. All 8 acceptance criteria pass.

issues: Fathima Telecaller row shows Deduction ‑₹32,000.02 and Net ‑₹0.02 (float rounding when all 26 days are absent) — cosmetic float-precision issue, pre-existing, unrelated to new payslip feature.

action_items: Configure/verify Resend sender domain (kmfoundation.online) to enable actual payslip email delivery — currently returns clean 400 as expected in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: payslipPdf.js loadLogoDataUri correctly handles auth-protected relative URLs by using api.get with blob responseType — good.
PayrollSection.downloadAll iterates rows sequentially with await inside for loop — safe but slow for large offices; consider Promise.all with concurrency cap.
downloadAll catch block only shows a generic toast; if one row's payslip endpoint fails, remaining downloads are aborted. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily edited SOURAV RAJ CM staff (id=e256d021-…) with TEST_QA_ designation/department/bank/ifsc to verify persistence; cleaned up (fields cleared) at end of test. Company profile PUT saved the pre-filled KM FOUNDATION defaults back to the collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll tab route: /attendance?tab=payroll (super_admin/office_admin only). Add-employee dialog on /employees pre-selects Type='Our Staff' → all cli-designation/department/doj/leave-balance/bank-acct/ifsc/tax-regime fields render immediately. On /clients the Add dialog defaults to Sub Agent — payslip fields only appear once Type is switched to Staff. Email toast text is exactly 'Email could not be sent — the sender domain isn't verified in Resend yet. Verify it at resend.com/domains, then try again.' (clean 400, no page blank). Company profile GET default legal_name='KM FOUNDATION (Zelix Ventures LLP)'.
